about: Names for TimeSplitters: Future Perfect (PAL default.xbe, title 0x45410066): the one place what we learn about the game is recorded. re/names.py applies it to the Ghidra project and generates src/tsfp_names.h. Addresses are guest VAs; keep entries sorted by address and give each a source.

functions.name: vblank_callback
functions.notes: The title's D3D vertical-blank callback: bumps g_vblank_counter.

functions.name: memcpy
functions.notes: MSVC CRT memcpy; replaced natively in src/recomp_manual.c (it jumps into its own middle).

functions.name: lang_string
functions.notes: Localised text by id (the loaded language's table at 0x6B7B08/0x6B7B10); 0 gives an empty string. Menu builders pass its result to menu_add_item/menu_add_choice.

functions.name: pads_assign_players
functions.notes: Fills g_player_port[] with the connected ports in order.

functions.name: pad_mask_buttons
functions.notes: Sets bits in PadState.mask and clears them from buttons: a held button is ignored until released.

functions.name: pad_neutralise
functions.notes: Clears a player's pad record to neutral (sticks 0x80, all buttons masked); called when a player has no control. Also called every frame by level 2's opening camera pan (script_camera_pan, pads 0 and 1) while the player's control flag stays set. Wrapped in src/recomp_manual.c: records which players were neutralised since the last poll, and mouse look is dropped for them.

functions.name: pads_neutralise_all
functions.notes: pad_neutralise for all four records.

functions.name: pad_set_deadzone
functions.notes: Sets PadState.deadzone; player_read_look_move sets 0.25 before reading the move stick.

functions.name: pad_axis
functions.notes: One analog input of a player's pad as -1..1 after the pad's deadzone (PadState.deadzone). axis: 1 lx, 2 ly, 3 rx, 4 ry, 5/6 triggers (PadState word 6 + axis). Returns 0 while g_pads_frozen.

functions.name: pad_axis_raw
functions.notes: pad_axis without scaling: the 0..255 byte (0x80 while g_pads_frozen).

functions.name: pad_axis_or_buttons
functions.sig: float pad_axis_or_buttons(int player, int axis, uint neg_buttons, uint pos_buttons)
functions.notes: pad_axis plus a digital direction from two buttons (the D-pad), clamped to -1..1.

functions.name: pads_update
functions.notes: Once a frame: polls all four ports into g_pads (pad_poll_port) and copies a few fields to 0x7E7220. Wrapped in src/recomp_manual.c to clear that record after the poll.

functions.name: character_anim_is
functions.notes: 1 when the character's current animation (character+4 -> +0xD4, or +0x12C) is anim.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: menu_cursor_on
functions.notes: Sets the current menu context's cursor-mode flag (MenuContext +0x10, 0x7BA270). Called by MapMaker screens only.

functions.name: menu_cursor_off
functions.notes: Clears the cursor-mode flag.

functions.name: menu_cursor_place
functions.notes: Cursor normalised position (+0x18/+0x1C) -> screen position (+0x20/+0x24) through the screen scale/offset at 0x7BA038/0x7BA188/0x7BA180/0x7BA184, clamped to the bounds at +0x48..+0x54 (sets flag bit 2 when clamped).

functions.name: menu_cursor_move_to
functions.notes: Puts the current context's cursor at a screen position (inverse of menu_cursor_place's mapping).

functions.name: menu_cursor_in_rect
functions.notes: Cursor inside rect[x0,y0,x1,y1], when the window has no captured part (+0x194 == -1) or it is this one.

functions.name: menu_item_under_cursor
functions.notes: Cursor over the item's rect (+0x78..+0x84) or, for option items, its value area (menu_item_value_rect). Disabled items (+0x28 bit 2) never match.

functions.name: menu_pick_item
functions.notes: The item under the cursor (topmost/first by position).

functions.name: menu_add_choice
functions.notes: Adds a value to the last-added option item (g_menu_last_item).

functions.name: menu_add_off_on
functions.notes: Adds the two choices lang 0x1837 / 0x1836 (Off/On) to the last option item.

functions.name: menu_item_rect
functions.notes: Item's screen rectangle from its layout position and the window's scroll.

functions.name: menu_scroll_update
functions.notes: Scrolls a list window by +0x98 per step on the shoulder bits, or when the cursor holds the scroll arrows (+0x18C == -3/-4).

functions.name: menu_read_pads
functions.notes: Turns the pads of the window's players (+0x3C mask) into menu button bits: +0xC4 pressed, +0xC8 held, with key repeat. In cursor mode the left stick moves the cursor instead of giving directions (with acceleration, +0x288/+0x28C) and the directional bits are skipped.

functions.name: menu_option_next
functions.notes: Next value of an option item.

functions.name: menu_option_prev
functions.notes: Previous value of an option item (skips disabled choices; numeric range mode when +0xB8 bit 0x200000: value -= step +0xA8, floor +0xA0).

functions.name: menu_begin_window
functions.sig: void menu_begin_window(uint flags, char *title, float width, int a, void *draw)
functions.notes: First call of a screen's build: header flags (0x2000 one-player screen, 0x8000 adds the Select/Back help lines), title, width. Acts on the window being built (0x7BB1E8).

functions.name: menu_draw_window
functions.sig: void menu_draw_window(MenuWindow *w, int pass, int depth)
functions.notes: Draws a window, its items (list +0x178, linked by +4) and recurses into child windows (+0x16C, linked by +0x30).

functions.name: menu_focus_id
functions.notes: Gives the focus to the window's item with that id (item +0x14).

functions.name: menu_cursor_to_focus
functions.notes: In cursor mode, moves the cursor to the centre of the focused item.

functions.name: menu_cursor_update
functions.notes: Cursor mode's replacement for up/down navigation: hit-tests the cursor against the scroll bar (part -2 thumb drag, -3/-4 arrows), the window and its items, focuses the item under the cursor (menu_focus_item) and records the cursor's relative position in the item (+0x1A0/+0x1A4).

functions.name: menu_draw_window_late
functions.notes: Second draw pass; in cursor mode calls the context's cursor-draw callback (MenuContext +0xF4, 0x7BA354) when set.

functions.name: menu_draw
functions.notes: menu_draw_window then menu_draw_window_late.

functions.name: menu_window_create
functions.notes: Takes a window from the pool at 0x6FEBE8, copies the descriptor's four words to +8..+0x14 and calls its build (+8) with the new window.

functions.name: menu_switch
functions.notes: Closes the root's other screens and opens desc's (menu_window_create), restoring the focus remembered for it.

functions.name: menu_open
functions.notes: Opens a screen on a root window and pushes it on the context's back stack. Descriptor = {build, update, 0, 0}; Controls is 0x524A40 {0x2EA8E0, 0x2EAB30}.

functions.name: menu_back
functions.notes: Pops the back stack and reopens the previous screen. Controls' Cancel (0x2E9EA0) is just menu_back(g_menu_roots[ctx]).

functions.name: menu_add_item
functions.sig: void menu_add_item(char *text, int id, uint flags, int a, void *on_accept, void *on_b)
functions.notes: Adds an item to the window being built (becomes g_menu_last_item, 0x7BB1D8). flags 0x10000 = button, 0x20000 = option row.

functions.name: menu_window_update
functions.notes: Per-frame logic of a window and its children: open/close fades, reads the pads (menu_read_pads), moves focus with up/down (or menu_cursor_update in cursor mode), left/right change the focused option (menu_option_prev/next), A runs the item's +0x38 callback / the window's +0x1BC, B the window's +0x1C0.

functions.name: menu_make_option
functions.notes: Turns g_menu_last_item into an option (value list) item.

functions.name: menu_click_option
functions.notes: A on an option item in cursor mode: hit-tests the cursor against the value area and, for kind 6, the left/right arrows (menu_option_prev/next).

functions.name: menu_item_activate_kind
functions.notes: A on an item, by kind (+0xB4): 2 -> 0x7FA00, 4 -> 0x75430, 5/6 -> menu_click_option (value area / arrows).

functions.name: pickup_touch
functions.notes: A character touched a pickup object: per-kind handler (bag_touch, weapons FUN_000c0310, health, armour, base_zone_touch, power-ups...); returns 1 when it was taken.

functions.name: pickup_touch_test
functions.notes: Per-frame test of one pickup against every character: height window, then horizontal distance^2 against the radius at (object+0x7C)->+0x18 +4, then pickup_touch. The radius jbe at 0x000C17D9 is reached from two comiss sites; the lifter left it as the never-set _flags, so every pickup was taken at load (fixed in the toolkit's flag-state merge).

functions.name: floor_height
functions.notes: Height of floor polygon `floor` under a point; -FLT_MAX (DAT_00478618) for none.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: floor_find
functions.sig: int floor_find(float *pos, float up, float radius)
functions.notes: The floor polygon under a point (0 for none).
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: collision_sweep
functions.sig: uint collision_sweep(world, float *from, float *to, float radius, float height, ...)
functions.notes: Swept collision test; the result's bits 0xE mean blocked.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: camera_default_fov
functions.notes: 45 (g_fov_default_alt) when c+0x254 == 0 and c+0x258 == 1, else 55 (g_fov_default).

functions.name: player_control_axis
functions.notes: The analog value of a control action through the player's control scheme: pad_axis(p->pad_index, p->control_axis[action]), or 0 when the action is unbound. Actions are listed under "actions".

functions.name: player_update_state10000
functions.notes: move_state 0x10000: drives two sub-objects' angles from both sticks.

functions.name: player_update_state400
functions.notes: move_state 0x400: a mounted or vehicle mode with its own yaw clamp (+-180) and look read from pad_axis 3/4 directly.

functions.name: player_state_dispatch
functions.notes: Switch on Player.move_state: 2 player_move_walk, 0x400 player_update_state400, 0x10000 player_update_state10000, and 4, 8, 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80, 0x100, 0x800, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0x20000, 0x40000, 0x100000.

functions.name: player_update
functions.notes: Per-frame update of g_player: saves prev yaw/pitch, player_read_look_move -> player_apply_look -> player_state_dispatch (movement per move_state) -> animation.

functions.name: character_to_nav_point
functions.sig: void character_to_nav_point(void *character, int point, int arg)
functions.notes: Places a character at a nav point (sub_000D6F60 writes its position).
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: game_clock_step
functions.notes: Caps the per-frame vblank step at 3 and accumulates g_game_clock.

functions.name: angle_limit
functions.sig: float angle_limit(float a, float lo, float hi)
functions.notes: Degrees: wraps to [-180,180) when hi-lo spans 360 (or lo == hi), else clamps to [lo,hi].

functions.name: vehicle_exit_clear
functions.sig: int vehicle_exit_clear(uint *seat) /* esi = vehicle, eax -> position */
functions.notes: 0 when the way from the seat to the position is clear (collision_sweep, then a floor under it), else -1.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: vehicle_dismount
functions.sig: void vehicle_dismount(void *vehicle, void *character, int exit_anim, int arg)
functions.notes: Takes a character out of its seat: with no exit animation (or vehicle_exit_clear failing) it is put at the nearest nav point (character_to_nav_point), else the exit animation plays.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: vehicle_rider_update
functions.notes: Per-seat update for cmd's character (cmd+0x1C handle, +0x18 flags): bit 0x40 (dismount requested) calls vehicle_dismount.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: vehicle_rider_action
functions.sig: int vehicle_rider_action(void *vehicle, void *character, int action, int arg)
functions.notes: An AI rider's vehicle action; action 0xD sets the dismount bit (0x40) in the command it hands to vehicle_rider_update.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: pad_poll_port
functions.notes: Reads XInputGetState for one port into a PadState: buttons through the table at 0x47DF00, analog buttons > 0x3C count as held, sticks and triggers mapped to 0..255 (0x80 centre) with the per-port calibration at 0x74D0A5 + port*0x19. Also sends rumble.

functions.name: script_camera_pan
functions.notes: A level-script action (level 2's opening, story/l_4_st.pak): each frame eases every player's yaw and pitch towards a target and calls pad_neutralise for pads 0 and 1, until the target is reached and the script moves on. The player's control flag stays set throughout.

functions.name: player_look_mounted
functions.sig: void player_look_mounted(void) /* eax = mounted object, ebx = look */
functions.notes: move_state 0x80 (mounted gun): turns the object's own angles, data = object+0x7C: pitch +0x1C (-= look.y), yaw +0x24 (+= look.x), roll +0x2C, limits +0x34/+0x38, +0x3C/+0x40, +0x44/+0x48 (equal = fixed), +0x5C sensitivity when +0x08 has 0x1000000. Wrapped in src/recomp_manual.c for the mouse.

functions.name: player_move_walk
functions.notes: move_state 2: on foot.

functions.name: aim_update
functions.notes: Called by player_update after player_apply_look with the raw look stick (before deadzone). Eases Player.crosshair_offset and Player.aim_offset towards a target: an auto-aim target's screen position, or look * -0.33 (+0.33 for y with invert look; halved when Controls.style == 2) -- what "Crosshair: On and moving" shows, a crosshair that leads the turn by up to a third of the way to the screen edge. Step per tick: (target - offset) * 0.1. The camera's turn (player_apply_look) does not read these offsets. Wrapped in src/recomp_manual.c to add the mouse's equivalent stick deflection.

functions.name: player_move_animation
functions.notes: Chooses the walk/strafe animation from the move vector.

functions.name: player_read_look_move
functions.notes: Reads g_player's look (action 0x11 negated = x, 0x10 = y; circular stick response look*|look|) and move (0x0E, 0x0F) inputs. The move rate may only change by a per-speed step from last frame's (Player.move_rate): that is the walking acceleration. Zeroes both while move_state has a bit of 0x22100. With aim_lock, or in move_state 0x40 (or 0x80 on a ladder-like object), it reads the alternate actions 0x12-0x15 instead and honours the profile's invert-look bit.

functions.name: player_look_seated
functions.sig: void player_look_seated(void) /* ebx = object, edi = look */
functions.notes: move_state 0x40: turns Player.yaw/pitch relative to the object's heading (object+0x70), clamped to the object's limits (same data offsets as player_look_mounted).

functions.name: player_apply_look
functions.notes: Integrates the look input into the camera angles: yaw += aim_turn_scale * g_yaw_speed * look.x * frame_time * (camera fov / default fov), wrapped to [0,360); pitch the same with g_pitch_speed, clamped to +-g_pitch_limit. Only while the player has control ((char)flags < 0, or camera mode 0x18) and move_state is not 0x20/0x40/0x80/0x100. Wrapped in src/recomp_manual.c to add mouse look. look_mode (Player+0x108) state machine, called as (look, move, look_out): 0 -> 2 when look_out.y == 0 and |move.x| > 0.75; 0 -> 1 when look_out.y != 0 and move.x != 0; 1 -> 0 when move.x == 0; 2 -> 1 when look_out.y != 0. In 2, when controls+2 bit 3 (auto-lookahead) is set, pitch -= pitch * ticks * 0.05 and the stick pitch is ignored, back to 1 within 0.5 degrees.

functions.name: ai_vehicle_update
functions.notes: AI per-tick vehicle behaviour; at 0x002A0C48 `test al,0x10; jne` skips action 0xD (dismount). The toolkit lifted that jne inverted (ZF-join fallback), so Captain Ash was ordered out of the gunner seat every third frame in the second level.
functions.source: secondlevel gunner-seat investigation (RAM bursts, write watch, Ghidra)

functions.name: settings_open_controls
functions.notes: Settings > Controls: copies the profile's Controls into the context's editing copy, plays 0xD1E, menu_open(g_menu_settings_root, 0x524A40).

functions.name: menu_build_settings
functions.notes: Front end's Settings screen: Audio/Video Options (0x2CBE10), Controls (0x2CBE50, opens on g_menu_settings_root), Copy Profile. PC Settings is added after Controls (recomp_manual.c).

functions.name: menu_build_controls
functions.notes: Builds the Controls screen (both the front end's and the pause menu's): option rows 0x1809 (control scheme), 0x17F6/0x1802/0x17F9 (Off/On), 0x17F7, 0x17CF, 0x1803 (5 choices), 0x1805, 0x180D, then Accept 0x1B08 (handler 0x002E9E50, the one fix 30 seeded; 0x002CBE00 when 0x79094C > 100) and Cancel 0x1B0B. The place to add PC rows.

functions.name: controls_screen_build
functions.notes: Controls screen's build (descriptor 0x524A40): menu_begin_window, menu_build_controls, help lines. The template for the PC Settings screen.

functions.name: pause_open_controls
functions.notes: Pause menu > Controls: as settings_open_controls but on g_menu_roots[w->context].

globals.name: g_ticks_per_frame
globals.notes: 2.0 at 60 Hz: vblanks per game frame (the game logic runs at 30).

globals.name: g_ticks_per_second
globals.notes: 60: frame_time = g_ticks_per_frame / g_ticks_per_second.

globals.name: g_vblank_counter
globals.notes: Bumped by vblank_callback (CLAUDE.md fix 16).

globals.name: g_player_port
globals.notes: Port of each player (pads_assign_players); the pad_* functions index it with the player number.

globals.name: g_pads
globals.notes: One PadState per port, 0x3C bytes each.

globals.name: g_pads_alt
globals.notes: Used instead of g_pads when 0x76B0FC is non-zero.

globals.name: g_pads_frozen
globals.notes: Non-zero: the pad getters return neutral values.

globals.name: g_game_clock
globals.notes: Game clock: accumulated vblank steps (CLAUDE.md fix 16; RECOMP_FPS_WATCH target).

globals.name: g_xinput_connected_mask
globals.notes: Bit per port.

globals.name: g_xinput_handles
globals.notes: XInputOpen handle per port.

globals.name: g_menu_settings_root
globals.notes: Root the front end's Settings screen opens Controls on.

globals.name: g_menu_roots
globals.notes: Root window per menu context; screens open on it with menu_open (pause menu's Controls, Controls' Cancel).

globals.name: g_menu_mode
globals.notes: Above 100 (0x65) in game (pause menus), below in the front end; builders pick layout and Accept/Cancel handlers by it.

globals.name: g_sin_table
globals.notes: sin over 2048 steps a turn; cos is index + 0x200.

globals.name: g_player
globals.notes: The player being updated (player_update runs once per local player).

globals.name: g_pitch_limit
globals.notes: 60.0: pitch is clamped to +-this (degrees).

globals.name: g_yaw_speed
globals.notes: 160.0: degrees a second at full look stick.

globals.name: g_pitch_speed
globals.notes: 68.0: degrees a second at full look stick.

globals.name: g_camera
globals.notes: The current player's camera.

globals.name: g_menu_contexts
globals.notes: One per menu context (MenuWindow +0x38), 0x1E0 bytes: +0 flags, +0xC top window, +0x10 cursor mode, +0x18/+0x1C cursor normalised, +0x20/+0x24 cursor on screen, +0x28.. cursor speed, +0x48..+0x54 cursor bounds, +0xF4 cursor-draw callback.

globals.name: g_menu_context
globals.notes: The context being updated or drawn.

globals.name: g_menu_last_item
globals.notes: The item menu_add_item made last; menu_make_option/menu_add_choice act on it.

globals.name: g_menu_building
globals.notes: The window a build function is filling; menu_begin_window and the help-line calls act on it.

fields.name: deadzone
fields.notes: pad_axis deadzone, 0..1

fields.name: buttons
fields.notes: game button bits (the table at 0x47DF00 maps XInput bits)

fields.name: pressed
fields.notes: went down this frame

fields.name: released
fields.notes: went up this frame

fields.name: axis0
fields.notes: axis slot 0, unused

fields.name: lx
fields.notes: 0..255, 0x80 centre

fields.name: ly
fields.notes: 0..255, up is above 0x80

fields.name: mask
fields.notes: buttons ignored until released (pad_mask_buttons)

structs.name: Player
structs.notes: The local player controller (g_player). Lives in contiguous memory (0x8xxxxxxx), which RECOMP_RAM_DUMP now writes as contig_<s>.bin.

fields.name: pad_index
fields.notes: player number handed to pad_axis (0 = player 1)

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: byte 0 bit 7: has control (player_apply_look integrates look only then)

fields.name: character
fields.notes: the character object; +0x7C its data

fields.name: control_axis
fields.notes: pad axis bound to each control action (player_control_axis)

fields.name: yaw
fields.notes: degrees, [0,360); grows turning right

fields.name: pitch
fields.notes: degrees, +-g_pitch_limit; positive looks up

fields.name: look_mode
fields.notes: 0/1/2 in player_apply_look: 0 standing, 1 moving with the look under the player's control, 2 walking forward with no look-y input (auto-lookahead levels the pitch when the profile has it)

fields.name: move_state
fields.notes: one bit: 2 on foot, 0x400 mounted, ... (player_state_dispatch); 0x22100 bits zero the look and move input

fields.name: speed_class
fields.notes: indexes the per-speed tables at 0x49F2A0

fields.name: yaw_prev
fields.notes: yaw at the start of player_update

fields.name: aim_lock
fields.notes: non-zero: player_read_look_move reads the alternate look/move actions

fields.name: crosshair_offset
fields.notes: screen offset of the crosshair, eased towards the look stick * -0.33 by aim_update (x: positive is right)

fields.name: aim_offset
fields.notes: the gun's aim offset, eased like crosshair_offset (aim_update)

fields.name: aiming
fields.notes: non-zero: aim_turn_scale eases to 0.65

fields.name: aim_turn_scale
fields.notes: 1.0, eases to 0.65 while aiming

fields.name: move_rate
fields.notes: last frame's accelerated move input (player_read_look_move)

fields.name: look_out
fields.notes: look input after player_apply_look's shaping

fields.name: controls
fields.notes: the profile's control settings (Controls)

fields.name: mode
fields.notes: *mode == 0x18: a camera mode in which look is integrated without player control

fields.name: fov
fields.notes: current field of view; zooming lowers it, and the look speed with it

structs.name: Controls
structs.notes: A profile's control settings, the Controls screen. Player.controls points at it.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: bit 0 inverse look, bit 3 auto-lookahead (player_apply_look levels the pitch while walking)

fields.name: style
fields.notes: 2: player_apply_look uses no stick deadzone (0.1 otherwise) and accelerates the look; aim_update halves the crosshair lead

fields.name: turn_speed
fields.notes: Turn Speed slider; the look is scaled by turn_speed + 0.5

structs.name: MenuContext
structs.notes: g_menu_contexts[MenuWindow.context]: the state one menu context (a player's set of windows) shares, including the cursor of cursor mode.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: bit 1: the cursor was clamped by menu_cursor_place

fields.name: top
fields.notes: the context's top window (menu focus follows it, 0x77470)

fields.name: cursor_mode
fields.notes: 1: cursor mode (menu_cursor_on); the left stick moves the cursor and items are picked by it

fields.name: cursor_x
fields.notes: normalised: screen = x0 + cursor_x * (x1 - x0) * 0.01

fields.name: cursor_sx
fields.notes: on screen, the units item rects use (menu_cursor_place)

fields.name: cursor_min_x
fields.notes: cursor bounds on screen

fields.name: x0
fields.notes: the context's screen rectangle (0x80EA0 makes the scale from it)

fields.name: cursor_draw
fields.notes: drawn by menu_draw_window_late in cursor mode when set

structs.name: MenuItem
structs.notes: One row of a menu window (MenuWindow.items, linked by next).

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: bit 2: disabled (skipped by navigation and the cursor), bit 0: no action

fields.name: on_accept
fields.notes: called with the window when A is pressed on the item

fields.name: sx0
fields.notes: screen rectangle, the cursor's units

fields.name: kind
fields.notes: 0 button, 1 value list (left/right only off cursor mode), 2, 4, 5/6 (clickable value/arrows, menu_click_option)

fields.name: choice
fields.notes: the value shown

fields.name: choices
fields.notes: 0x14 bytes each

structs.name: MenuWindow
structs.notes: A menu screen or panel: items, child windows, per-frame button bits.

fields.name: style
fields.notes: callbacks and timings shared by a kind of window

fields.name: context
fields.notes: index into g_menu_contexts

fields.name: players
fields.notes: bit per player whose pad drives it

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: 0x40000: ignores cursor mode

fields.name: pressed
fields.notes: menu button bits this frame (menu_read_pads): bit n | bit n+16 when it went down; 0x10 A, 0x20 B, 0x10000/0x20000 up/down, 0x40000/0x80000 left/right

fields.name: children
fields.notes: linked by +0x30
